task: AI-guided inverse-design framework for recyclable vitrimeric polymers

named_methods.molecular_dynamics: MD simulations provide raw Tg estimates
named_methods.gaussian_process_calibration: GP regression mapping MD Tg to experimental Tg
named_methods.graph_variational_autoencoder: Graph VAE for molecular latent space representation and generation
named_methods.inverse_design: Latent space optimization targeting desired Tg ranges

data_sources.tg_calibration: 295 polymers with experimental and MD Tg values
data_sources.tg_vitrimer_MD: 8424 vitrimer systems (acid+epoxide pairs) with MD Tg values

validation_approach: Comparison of predicted vs calibrated/experimental Tg for generated candidates
